He’s fierce, wild, and refuses to admit he likes me… but he’s a great cook, blushes whenever he kisses me, and is honestly adorable.
The only problem is… his chuunibyou is a bit serious.
He keeps saying he’s inherited memories from the future, that I’ll eventually become humanity’s ultimate destroyer. The future’s biggest BOSS and that one day, he’ll have to kill me.
Me: “Mhm, sure, baby.”
Until one morning, I opened my eyes to find him standing at my bedside, dressed head-to-toe in black combat gear. Polished leather boots on my bed. A gun pointed straight at me. mu*derous intent flashing in his eyes.
“S-Class Calamity ‘Huo Yan.” You’ve finally awakened,” he said coldly.
Instantly wide awake, I slapped his boot in mock anger. “How could you step on the bed with your shoes on?”
His hand holding the gun faltered for a second. He brushed my hand away.
It was then I realized… this wasn’t play-acting anymore.
I slowly pulled the blanket over half my face, feeling a little embarrassed. “W-Why are you being so intense this early in the morning…”
Jiang Ce: “…”
Later, I learned two things:
First, my little boyfriend, Jiang Ce, future Captain of the Special Incident Division’s First Squad, had truly awakened his future memories.
Second, on the day of the Alien Invasion, I regained my own memories. I really was the rumored S-Class Calamity: Huo Yan.
Now I have two problems:
One, Jiang Ce thinks I’ve stolen Huo Yan’s body, but the truth is, it’s been me all along. I’m just… not always great at pretending to be human.
Two, destroying Blue Star sounds boring. My little boyfriend is way more tempting. How do I convince him that “Huo Yan” is already dead?
Ah…
Being human is so hard.

113336.synopsis:
“Hahaha! Say goodbye to your manhood!”
These were the last words transmigrator Xue Ji heard before defeating the Demon King. When he came to his senses, he found himself back on Earth—reborn as a cute silver-haired girl, and his life promptly turned into absolute chaos.
Now, as the returned Sage during Earth’s spiritual resurgence, she’s ready to forge a new legend! But between hidden yandere lovers from past lives, a sentient bratty superpower with a mind of its own, and a shamelessly straightforward beast-eared girl, her new existence quickly spirals into madness.
Watch as the great Sage navigates spiritual awakening, supernatural battles, and the most treacherous battlefield of all: her own romantic minefield!

115128.synopsis:
“How the hell did he create this?”
A genius programmer obsessed with code—Baek In-wook.
He was the kind of man who could glance at any program and instantly grasp its core logic.
And for three years, he stubbornly reverse-engineered one game.
The one and only.
The so-called “perfect game from the realm of the impossible to develop” — The Chronicles of Terrasia.
In that perfection, he found a single loose thread.
And the moment he sent in a bug report—
[Would you like to fix this magic yourself?] 
He had become a mage in a world where the tutorial survival rate was only 8%!
And before his eyes was the code of magic itself.
“If this world—if magic itself—is built like a programming language…”
“Then what if I could copy this code, modify it… maybe even rewrite everything?”

115640.synopsis:
Shou is a total heartthrob * Eight-year age gap * Gong is head over heels for shou * Super strong control freak
Fang Shimian was riding his little electric scooter when he stumbled upon a chain car accident scene. On the deserted mountain road, he pulled a man out of a Maybach that was about to explode. The man’s face was cold and stern, covered in blood. Fang Shimian didn’t have time to hesitate; he took the man and started running for their lives. As the last rays of the sunset faded, the vehicle erupted with a violent sound, and a wave of heat and debris came crashing down. The little scooter was blown to bits. He even gave his life-saving helmet to the guy. But the man remained unconscious, looking like he wouldn’t make it. Fang Shimian stumbled and ran a long way to lead an ambulance up, and after saving the man, he left without a trace. He ran away. Until not long after, he was brought to the hospital room by those burly black-suited bodyguards. Seeing the tall and handsome group president calmly flipping through documents on the hospital bed, he realized he had really saved a life.
Mini Theater:
After successfully getting his driver’s license, Fang Shimian sent the driver away and drove himself to pick up Huo Zhongshan from work. When he arrived at the Hengshi Group building, the receptionist said Huo Zhongshan was in a meeting and that he could wait in the lounge if he didn’t have an appointment. Fang Shimian waited in the lounge for a while, feeling a bit hungry, and knowing Huo Zhongshan’s meetings usually took a long time, he decided to go out and grab a bite to eat. In the nearby food court, Fang Shimian happily bought a bunch of his favorite snacks and headed back. He hadn’t even finished his pineapple burger when he saw Huo Zhongshan coming out of the building with a group, looking grim and not in a good mood. Fang Shimian stopped, glanced at the unhealthy food in his hand, and turned to leave, only to be caught after a few steps. “Anything else?” The suit-clad group president calmly took the snacks from Fang Shimian’s hand. “Next time, just take the elevator up and wait in my office.” Under the watchful eyes of the group employees, Huo Zhongshan naturally delegated the remaining tasks to his subordinates, carrying the colorful bags, and went home with Fang Shimian.

116664.synopsis:
Fang Ruotang, a frail and unremarkable girl from the Prime Minister’s household,
one day found herself pestered by a tiny, cutesy creature called the Mirror of Reversal—
and it started spilling all sorts of shocking secrets.
Like how:
Prince An is madly in love with her,
willing to become her secret lover, hidden in the shadows.
The Crown Prince will stop at nothing to claim her for himself.
A young prince will rebel for her sake.
Even a once-celebrated top scholar would become her loyal lapdog.
…
The little mirror claimed these men would all fall in love with her,
live for her, die for her,
and bash their heads against walls for her.
Fang Ruotang: Is this little fluffball out of its d**n mind?
What if it’s just a trick sent by Grandfather’s political enemies,
trying to lead her astray so they can get her family impeached?
Shameless. Absolutely vile!
Oh, and as for Young Lord Rong…
“You shut up. He’s my future brother-in-law.”
Mirror: “Fine, but what about General Huo? Great body, great looks, top-tier family and skills—plus an eight-pack.”
Fang Ruotang: “…”
associated_names: 心声泄露后，所有人都来攻略我

117176.synopsis:
Lin Anran transmigrated into a novel set in the 1990s—not as the heroine, not even the villainess, but as a nameless side character: the humble nanny working for the future power couple. Her only line in the entire book?
“Please wait, sir is on the phone.”
Lin Anran: …Seriously?
But fate had other plans. After crossing paths with a certain someone, things changed. When the main couple came knocking again, her words became:
“Please wait, my husband is on the phone.”
****
Zhou Heyuan had it all—born into privilege, raised in a prestigious military compound, blessed with good looks and a genius mind. He built a business empire in his early twenties and became a billionaire almost overnight. Countless socialites and heiresses had their eyes on him…
But before anyone could make a move, he got married.
And his bride? A village girl with only a middle school education, divorced for being “infertile,” working as a nanny!
The world was stunned. Everyone swore they’d divorce in no time.
While the world watched and waited for the split, Lin Anran used her transmigrator’s golden cheat—growing rare orchids, creating beauty and skincare products, and building a loyal customer base. She opened her own salon and transformed herself into a wealthy, independent queen.
As for the husband? Let him play by himself for now. She’d deal with him after making her fortune.
Zhou Heyuan: …

117688.synopsis:
At the start, Su Chen was buried alive by his fiancée.
In despair, Su Chen activated the True Dragon Holy Body and went back to seek revenge on his fiancée, but unexpectedly, he mistook the fiancée’s older sister…
After some actions, Su Chen then discovered the wonders of the True Dragon Holy Body.
He is a divine doctor, he is a Feng Shui master, he is a martial artist, and he is also a walking Tang Monk Physique.
“Damn it, who spread the word about my Tang Monk physique? Now the goddesses won’t be able to restrain themselves!”
associated_names: 被未婚妻背叛，她目睹我无敌后泪崩

118712.synopsis:
Someone once asked Lu Chao how he became the youngest Minister of Works in the dynasty. What was his secret?
Lu Chao glanced at the person beside him and smiled, “First, you need to have a general’s wife.”
This is the story of Lu Chao, a modern-day workhorse who accidentally time-traveled to ancient times. Though he initially planned to coast through life, he ultimately rose to become one of the era’s most revered statesmen.

119224.synopsis:
Fang Zichen is an outstanding top student who suddenly finds himself transported to another world, where he gains a male wife and a son.  
The male wife was forced into marriage.
The son came as part of a “buy-one-get-one-free” deal.
Fang Zichen: “At eighteen, I’ve got a wife, a son, and a warm bed. This is the peak of life! Who can top that?”  
However, reality hits hard: The house is empty, and the top student doesn’t know how to do anything, so he has no choice but to carry heavy sacks at the docks in town.  
The villagers pity Zhao ger, saying his life is bitter. After toiling like an ox for the Ma family for twelve years, they sold him and his son to Fang Zichen.  
Fang Zichen, an outsider with nothing to his name except his handsome face, doesn’t even own a scrap of land. He lives in a crumbling, abandoned house from the village chief’s family. He is so poor that even flies refuse to fly into his home.  
Zhao ger had truly jumped from one pit of fire into another—how tragic!
But as it turns out, the couple thrives.  
Zhao ger starts a business, selling roast duck and sausages that become popular in town. Meanwhile, Fang Zichen returns to his studies, passing each imperial exam step by step
And despite all this, he still comes home to wash Zhao ger’s feet.  
Villagers: “Is this even a pit of fire? I’d jump into ten of these if I could!”  
Fang Zichen happily raises his son, living his best life. His classmates and friends see the child and can’t help but praise, “Your son looks just like you!”  
At first, Fang Zichen doesn’t pay much attention—until his stepson turns six, growing more handsome by the day, and increasingly familiar.  
Before Fang Zichen can demand an explanation from Zhao ger, he stumbles upon a shocking truth. Zhao ger has always had a white moonlight in his heart, someone he’s never forgotten all these years—and that Fang Zichen is just a substitute.  
Fang Zichen: “…”  
“Zhao ger, I’ll f*ck your ancestors!”  
In a fit of rage, Fang Zichen scribbles a divorce letter, snatches the child, and flees without a second thought. Meanwhile, back in the capital, Zhao ger clutches the divorce letter, his eyes bloodshot, and coughs up blood in despair
He hunts down his runaway husband, cornering him in a stinking latrine.
“Either come back with me, or I’ll drown you in this latrine.”  
Fang Zichen refuses to yield: “…The latrine stinks too much. Fine, I’ll go back with you.”  
Fang Zichen decides to return to the capital to confront this white moonlight—only to find out who it really is.  
Fang Zichen: “…Well, I’m doomed.”  
The white moonlight is handsome, brilliant, unbeatable in both wit and strength—utterly untouchable.
Fang Zichen’s only thought: Retreat!

121528.synopsis:
Shi You met a guy—her brother’s good friend. He’s not only handsome and easygoing, but also a MotoGP champion. He buys strawberries to cheer her up and wins lollipop bouquets just for her. A cunning flirt, he loves teasing her.
“Kid, are you abandoning me?”
With a smile in his eyes, he says, “My life is in your hands. If you run away, what am I supposed to do?”
—
Shi You stuffed the money she earned from selling apples into his arms.
“Here, this is your payment. You’ve worked hard!”
“But I don’t need money.”
“Then what do you need?”
“Something warm.”
“Like what?”
“Your hands.”
Shi You wrapped her hands around his.
“Like this?”
“Yeah.”
“Still cold?”
He shifted his grip, interlacing their fingers tightly.
“Nope, now it’s warm.”

127160.synopsis:
Young doctor Chen Baian is just a very ordinary resident physician in standardized training!
His aptitude is limited, he can’t win the rat race, but he’s unwilling to give up.
Just as medical reforms are underway, an annual salary system that prioritizes ability is implemented. Geniuses emerge in droves-young department directors, young tech gurus-the capable reign supreme.
Chen Baian was destined to be a background character, but fortunately, he acquired the Doctor Simulator. By treating diseases, he can earn simulation time. This time can be used for simulations to acquire medical skills, fortuitous encounters, and more.
Simulate Incision for 5 days: Incision (Novice) → Incision (Skilled)
Simulate Appendectomy for 1 year: Appendectomy (Novice) → Appendectomy (Expert)
Simulate Scoliosis Correction Surgery for 40 years: Scoliosis Correction Surgery (Novice) → Scoliosis Correction Surgery (National Master)
Chen Baian quietly hunkered down in the operating room and the emergency department, doing his job. Years later, a man who only wanted to be a good doctor unexpectedly became the best, an omnipotent physician.
I am not a genius, and this world has many geniuses. But being a genius is merely the entry ticket to meet me…
associated_names: 从治病救人苟到全能大医

128184.synopsis:
On the day her ex-boyfriend abandoned her, heavy snow fell over Beicheng.
Zhong Xiran stood in the endless whiteness, her body stiff with cold, until Qi Sinian appeared and pulled her into his car.
In his calm voice, he said:
“Breakups happen. You and he were never a perfect match anyway.”
Later, they married for family interests, becoming husband and wife in name only.
One day, Zhong Xiran suddenly asked him:
“Then who do you think I’d be a perfect match with?”
Qi Sinian, sitting on the sofa with a magazine, looked up at her:
“You’re already mine. Why would I let you be a match with anyone else?”
“…”
It wasn’t until much later that Zhong Xiran realized,
Qi Sinian had secretly loved her for a very long time.

204728.synopsis:
Transmigrating into the Immortal Ancient Era, I became the youngest Supreme Being of that generation, and I even have a system—life is good.
Wait, these are both great things, so why is it so tragic when combined?
At the end of the Immortal Ancient Era, Zhang Daoyuan looked up to see the heavens collapsing and the earth shattering.
The Immortal Bell of Wuzhong Immortal King was broken, and the Samsara Disk of Six Paths Reincarnation Immortal King was shattered.
The Foreign Territory is invading!
The system has awakened, but it’s malfunctioning!
“Heavenly Emperor System activated. In the Post-Desolate Ancient Era, cultivation is difficult. Detected that the host has successfully embarked on the Path of Cultivation and made contact with the cultivation world. Consuming the Nine Marvels Undying Divine Medicine.”
“Reward: Activate the Desolate Ancient Sacred Body! Create the Sea of Bitterness.”
Zhang Daoyuan: “?”
Is this still the Immortal Ancient Era? System, where did you send me?
No, wait—System, where did you go?
